title: 第24章 跑得倒是快
novel_title: 长生：我体内有一片坟陵
content_zh:
“轰隆隆~”

    惊雷炸响，枝丫般的闪电撕裂昏暗的天幕，将窗外的庭院映出一瞬惨白。

    齐子濯起身移步至窗前，背着双手望着外边的雨幕。

    老青两代人安静地赏着雨景，听着雨声。

    不多时，齐子濯返回床前入座，重新捡起话题道：“你这边是否有事急需善后？如今你行动不便，老夫或可替你跑动一二。”

    苏牧对视看去，迟疑一瞬道：“李构相关我已悉数告知聂无极，他还曾提出让我加入望月峰作他弟子，应无后患，不知齐老对望月峰的情况有多少了解？”

    齐子濯目光一闪，意识到对方身上还藏着不可告人的秘密，轻轻点头道：“看来你是拒绝了。”

    他抬手将墙角的一张四方案几移至旁边，又从储物袋里取出茶壶和小炉子，然后以法力牵引室外的雨水，炼化纯净，开始煮水泡茶。

    炉火在昏暗的卧房里映出一小团暖黄的光晕，水汽升腾，茶香在雨声中弥漫开来。

    “青云宗分峰而治，六大山头有相当自主权，有各自的规矩，老夫也不甚了解，所知仅限于表面，涉及不到私密。”

    齐子濯边烫洗杯子，边道：“其中望月峰属于老牌山头，传承至今，聂无极已是第九代峰主，因为他师尊化魔，当年望月峰被清理了一批弟子，元气大伤，至今都未恢复过来，单从弟子人数和金丹强者数量来说，属于五大峰中最弱的。”

    苏牧满脸兴致，挪动背部稍稍换了个姿势，道：“我说望月峰人数怎么这么少，好像才三、四十个？其它五峰都有百人左右，人数最多的青霄峰都超过二百人了。”

    眨眼顿了下，他又狐疑道：“不对啊，我听说各峰都有仙苗名额，我经历过两次大招募，每次都有不少天灵根和上品真灵根直接进入内门，事情过去一百多年，不至于才这点人吧？”

    齐子濯抬眸瞧去一眼，笑了笑解释道：“分峰而治的目的是为了发挥强者的优势，延续传承，走的是精英弟子策略。”

    “但各峰还是归宗门主峰统管，受到制约，所以各峰招纳弟子的名额是有限制的。”

    “以金丹强者为基数，一名金丹强者，每次只能分到一个天灵根，前提还得每次招到足够的天灵根，主峰分配完了，再给各峰。”

    “当然，对宗门有特殊重大贡献，分峰可以多要到名额，或者自己私下去找。”

    “而望月峰，血煞门事件后，只余两名金丹强者，二十年前聂无极的大弟子突破至金丹境，情况才好些。”

    苏牧愣了愣问：“望月峰有三个金丹期？还有一个是谁？怎么没听说过？”

    齐子濯轻叹一声道：“聂无极的小师妹，也是他师尊的女儿，那次大战之后便一直待在望月峰闭关，没再露面，后来入宗的弟子，都不知道她的存在。”
content_en:
"Boom~"

    Thunder exploded, and branch-like lightning tore through the dim sky, making the courtyard outside the window pale for a moment.

    Qi Zi stood up and moved to the window, looking at the rain outside with his hands behind his back.

    The old and young generations quietly enjoyed the rain scene and listened to the sound of rain.

    Not long after, Qi Zizuo returned to the bed and sat down. He picked up the topic again and said, "Is there something urgent about your side that needs to be sorted out? Now that you have difficulty moving, I might be able to run around for you."

    Su Mu looked at each other, hesitated for a moment and said: "I have told Nie Wuji everything about Li Gou. He also asked me to join Wangyue Peak as his disciple. There should be no future troubles. I wonder how much Mr. Qi knows about the situation at Wangyue Peak?"

    Qi Zizuo's eyes flashed, and he realized that the other party still had hidden secrets. He nodded lightly and said, "It seems that you refused."

    He raised his hand and moved the four-plan table in the corner to the side, and took out the teapot and small stove from the storage bag. Then he used his magic to draw the rainwater outside, refine it and purify it, and began to boil water to make tea.

    The fire reflected a small warm yellow halo in the dim bedroom, water vapor rose, and the fragrance of tea filled the air amidst the sound of rain.

    "Qingyun Sect is divided into peaks. The six mountains have considerable autonomy and have their own rules. I don't know much about it. What I know is only superficial and does not involve privacy."

    Qi Zizhuo was scalding the cup and said, "Among them, Wangyue Peak is an old mountain. It has been passed down to this day. Nie Wuji is the ninth-generation peak master. Because his master turned into a demon, a group of disciples were purged from Wangyue Peak back then. Their vitality was severely damaged and they have not recovered yet. In terms of the number of disciples and the number of powerful golden elixirs, it is the weakest among the five peaks."

    Su Mu was full of interest, moved his back and changed his position slightly, and said: "I wonder why there are so few people in Wangyue Peak, only about thirty or forty people? There are about a hundred people in the other five peaks, and Qingxiao Peak, which has the largest number of people, has more than 200 people."

    After blinking and pausing, he said suspiciously: "That's not right. I heard that each peak has a quota for immortal seedlings. I have gone through two large-scale recruitments. Each time, a lot of heavenly spiritual roots and high-grade true spiritual roots entered the inner gate directly. It has been more than a hundred years, so it's not like there are just this few people, right?"

    Qi Zizhuo raised his eyes and took a look, smiled and explained: "The purpose of dividing the peaks and conquering them is to give full play to the advantages of the strong and continue the inheritance. It is an elite disciple strategy."

    "But each peak is still under the control of the main peak of the sect and is subject to restrictions, so the number of disciples each peak can recruit is limited."

    "Based on the Golden Core strongman, a Golden Core strongman can only be allocated one Heavenly Spirit Root at a time. The prerequisite is that enough Heavenly Spiritual Roots must be recruited each time. After the main peak is allocated, it will be distributed to each peak."

    "Of course, if you have made special and significant contributions to the sect, you can ask for more quotas from the branch peak, or you can find them privately."

    "On Wangyue Peak, after the Blood Demon Sect incident, there were only two golden elixir masters left. Twenty years ago, Nie Wuji's eldest disciple broke through to the golden elixir realm, and the situation became better."

    Su Mu was stunned and asked: "There are three golden elixir stages in Wangyue Peak? Who is the other one? Why haven't you heard of it?"

    Qi Zizuo sighed softly and said: "Nie Wuji's younger junior sister is also the daughter of his master. After the battle, she stayed in the Moon Peak Peak for retreat and never showed up again. The disciples who later joined the sect did not know her existence."
